case.component: BACK OVER PREVENTION: REARVIEW SYSTEM BRAKING
case.narrative: THE BLIND SPOT MONITORING STOPS AFTER A FEW MINUTES ON THE HIGHWAY. DEALER SAID NO TROUBLE FOUN D. WHEN IN TRAFFIC IT STOPS WORKING, BACKING UP NO NOTIFICATION CROSS TRAFFIC, CARGO DOOR STUCK OPEN. ADTER 10 MINUTES SHUTTING OFF CAR. RESTARTING, TRYING INSIDE BUTTON, DOOR BUTTON AND THE REMOTE. THEY ALL FAILED TO CLOSE DOOR. HAD TO MANUALLY CLOSE CARGO HATCH. IT WORKED THE NEXT MORNING. THE BLIND SPOT, CROSS TRAFFIC DOESNT WORK! IT WORKS FOR A FEW MINUTES AFTER STARTING CAR BUT UNDER TRAFFIC CONDTIONS IT FAILS TO NOTIFY ON BOTH SIDES OF THE VEHICLE. IT FAILED FIRST ON PASSENGER SIDE. NOW BOTH SIDES FAIL IN HEAVY TRAFFIC CONDITIONS.  I HAVE VIDEOS TO PROVE THE FAILURES.

decision.rationale: Safety flag stands; the case keeps priority for a live engineer.
